title: Odyssey of the Mind official score calculation protocol

components.name: Long-Term problem
components.exception: Unless the problem states otherwise; structure problems may use problem-specific scoring.

raw_categories.name: Overall effect of the four Style elements

components.name: Spontaneous
components.raw_scoring: Defined by the specific verbal, hands-on, or verbal/hands-on problem read in the competition room.

final_score.penalty_timing: Penalties are deducted after component scores are calculated.

placement.tie_rule: A tie is declared when a team's score is less than 1.00 point below the highest score assigned to that place.
placement.ranking_requirement: A team must present a Long-Term solution to receive Long-Term and Style scores and to be ranked.

applicability.scope: Current standard Odyssey of the Mind tournament score calculation.
applicability.benchmark_coverage: Public spontaneous examples and historical Long-Term problem synopses.
applicability.problem_specific_control: The applicable full Long-Term problem and current Program Guide control whenever they specify different scoring.

provenance.title: Odyssey of the Mind Program Guide

limitations: Historical synopsis pages do not contain the complete problem-specific scoring categories or penalties.
Raw Long-Term and Spontaneous dimensions cannot be generalized across problems.
Calculated scores depend on the highest raw score in the same problem and division, so an isolated submission cannot receive an official calculated score.
Structure-problem scoring has changed over time and requires the specific edition's full problem.
